title: EmbedToken
description: Authenticated-embed token shape consumed by /embed/maps/{id}. Mint and verify are owned by honua-server; portal #15 only consumes the resolved descriptor. Tokens are opaque to clients — the `token` string is the bearer; `itemId`, `closure`, and `expiresAt` are mirrored back from the verify endpoint so portal can render a coherent surface without re-fetching.

token.description: Opaque bearer token. Sent in the URL fragment as `#embedToken=…` so it never reaches access logs. Never written to localStorage.

itemId.description: Single item id this token authorizes. Tokens are scoped per-item — they cannot be replayed against other items.

audience.description: Audience label captured at mint time. Used for telemetry and revocation grouping; not authoritative for access checks.

expiresAt.description: Server-assigned expiry. ttl ≤ 7 days enforced server-side.

closure.description: Snapshot of dependency item ids the token authorizes alongside the primary item. Captured at mint time so subsequent dep changes do not silently widen the token.
